headline: Modest global sales growth, US traffic still soft
summary_short: McDonald's Q3 revenue of $7.16B rose 1% y/y and GAAP EPS of $3.51 rose 10%. Global comparable sales grew 1.5% while US comps slipped 0.2%.
summary_long: Operating income rose 7% (8% excluding restructuring charges of $56M vs $39M a year ago), helped by higher other operating income and sales-driven franchised margins. International Developmental Licensed comps rose 4.2% and International Operated 1.4%; in the US, negative guest counts were largely offset by check growth. Systemwide sales rose 4% to over $38B. The quarterly dividend was raised 4% to $1.93. The release gives no financial guidance.
confidence_notes: Non-GAAP EPS excludes $0.06 of restructuring charges (prior year $0.04). Y/y deltas computed from reported dollar values; the comp-sales deltas are percentage-point differences vs the prior-year quarter's comps (3.6% global, 2.4% US). The shard's Yahoo EPS value of 3.57 matches the company's non-GAAP figure.

drivers.explanation: Excluding charges, results were primarily driven by higher other operating income and higher sales-driven franchised margins.
Negative comparable guest counts were largely offset by positive check growth.
Developmental Licensed markets were positive in all regions, led by Japan and partly offset by China; Operated Markets led by Germany and Australia, partly offset by France.
Franchised revenues rose 3% and other revenues 26%, partly offset by a 3% decline in company-operated restaurant sales.
